newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Firstone sells HK$50 mln preference shrs.
newsitem.headline: Firstone sells HK$50 mln preference shrs.

text.p: Capacitors maker Firstone International Holdings Ltd said on Monday one of its substantial shareholders, Prestbury Incorporated Ltd, had agreed to buy 50 convertible preference shares of the company for HK$50 million.
Holders of the preference shares are entitled to convert into ordinary shares at HK$0.40 per share at any time before the third anniversary of the issuance of the preference shares.
Firstone shares were unchanged at HK$0.335 in mid-morning.

Prestbury's stake would be increased to 42.34 percent of the expanded share capital of Firstone on full conversion of the preference shares, from 26.51 percent as at September 19, and a general offer would be required, the statement said.
Preference share holders are also entitled to receive a fixed accumulative preferencial dividend at the rate of 7.5 per cent per annum payable half-yearly.

The company's chairman Wan Sitt Kam said the sale of preference shares would have the effect of improving the financial position of the company by reducing its leverage and enlarging its capital base.
